title: Understanding Gradient Descent
text: Gradient descent is an optimization algorithm used to minimize a function by iteratively moving towards the steepest descent direction. It updates parameters to reduce the loss function.

title: Batch vs Stochastic Gradient Descent
text: Batch gradient descent computes the gradient using the entire dataset, while stochastic gradient descent uses a single data point at each iteration.

title: True Gradient in Gradient Descent
text: In batch gradient descent, the true gradient of the loss function is computed using all data points. In stochastic gradient descent, the gradient is an approximation based on a single data point.
